posts.author: Sasami
posts.body:
Not sure if this belongs here, but I'm having trouble to figure out how to change an actor's image during battle when in a certain state when an enemy put a debuff on you.
For example, if the actor is in a sleeping state that was induced by an enemy, I want to make them look like they're sleeping by swapping the actor image only during this state.(switches back to original once they wake up)
This is a little different, but I used this tutorial- it worked, but this is changing the actor's image from the actor's skill, not done my an enemy.
(not sure if I can post youtube links here, if not, I will edit it out)

Click to expand...
Do you know this is built into MZ? It's in your state settings:
The SV battler spritesheet has three motions built into it to indicate negative status effects. (and there are also the State Overlay settings for additional graphical indications)
Is there a reason you need to actually change the entire spritesheet rather than this?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Oh. That's pretty different from your first post, where you talked about changing the actor image (as opposed to face) and linked a video which changed the battler.
I would recommend
@Eliaquim
's Faces Reaction plugin for this:
Hakuen Studio Faces Reaction for RPG MAKER MZ by Hakuen Studio
Change Actor faces according to states and battle actions!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
You just set it up in the plugin and it works.
Your next best bet would be using my Eval Tags or VisuStella's Skills and States Core to execute code when a state is applied and when it wears off.
But those options require you to know/look up/ask for help with the JavaScript to do it, whereas the first plugin will just go.

It's actually a reference to Father Stephen O'Mori of County Claire, Ireland. Notorious RPG maker dev and activist to try and get fewer allegories for the Catholic Church as the primary antagonist in JRPGs.
